assumptions: Usage tier: Simple text – chat, search, summaries (0.34 Wh per prompt).
Boundary: Onsite cooling plus water consumed generating the electricity (~4.1 mL/Wh; US grid average per Li et al.).
Chat-style prompts (one prompt, one response). Agentic sessions can be far higher – use estimate_session_footprint.
Uses the most conservative (highest) of the published onsite water intensities. Excludes model training.
Likely range 0.3x–3x the central estimate: a judgement-based summary of how much published per-prompt energy figures and provider/grid water intensities vary, not a statistical interval.
